verdict.rationale: Muse documents that once a user sets a goal or task, it keeps working on a schedule and in response to relevant events. It also monitors and follows up after the app is closed, so the product itself provides event-driven automatic action. However, this is goal-driven agent behavior, not an explicit user-defined rule system with configurable triggers and actions. Missing for 10: explicit rule or trigger definition (if-event-then-action configuration), documentation of which event types are supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-triggered execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Once you've set a goal or a task, Muse continues to work on a schedule and in response to relevant events, taking the next step and following up
The Goals tab is where Muse keeps track of all this for you, and you can interact directly there or talk to it about these tasks in chat.
Muse keeps things moving after you close the app. It monitors, follows up, and sends a notification when something needs your attention
